cases: Macro-enabled XLSM/VBA content is rejected before semantic parsing.
XLSX containing vbaProject.bin or macro relationship is rejected.
Formula in authoritative Network Elements cell is rejected; cached value is not accepted as source truth.
Formula in authoritative IP Addresses cell is rejected.
External workbook link relationship is rejected.
DDE/external data connection or query-table relationship is rejected.
Path traversal ZIP entry is rejected.
Duplicate normalized ZIP entry/path alias is rejected.
ZIP entry count above bound is rejected.
Total uncompressed size above bound is rejected.
Workbook file size above configured bound is rejected before full parse.
Cell text above byte bound is rejected/bounded without log/body disclosure.
Row count above Network Elements bound is rejected.
IP row count above bound is rejected.
Unsupported workbook version is rejected without domain mutation.
Missing required Metadata key is rejected.
Duplicate required Metadata key is rejected.
Unknown credential-like header such as Password/PrivateKey/Token is rejected as SECRET_FIELD_FORBIDDEN.
Topology/interface/port/reachability header is rejected as TOPOLOGY_FIELD_FORBIDDEN.
Hidden sheet cannot smuggle authoritative rows; only exact profile sheets are parsed and forbidden active content still rejected.
Foreign-installation local IDs are parsed only as provenance and never direct overwrite authority.
Malformed/non-UUID same-installation local identity is rejected as invalid row.
Malformed integer Rack U values such as 1.5/scientific text are rejected rather than rounded.
IP CIDR/network text is rejected where host address is required.
Source workbook remains byte-for-byte unchanged after successful staging/review.
Source workbook remains unchanged after failed/unsafe parse.
Generated template/discovery/round-trip workbook contains no macros, formulas, external links, secrets or topology columns.
Generated workbook is reopened and profile/row counts/hash verified before export metadata is committed.
Logical fingerprint ignores row order but preserves duplicate multiplicity and normalized values.
Hash/logical fingerprint is treated only as replay identity and never authentication/trust proof.
Unsafe workbook error/audit output contains bounded filename/reason/fingerprint metadata only, not cell bodies or secrets.
gate: The same pinned XLSX dependency must also pass the shared malicious-workbook fixtures used by LLD-04; a failure in either suite blocks dependency acceptance.
